source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U11: Apply good faith,disclosure,management and consent rules between partners

payload.title: Internal voting does not remove duties of loyalty
payload.core_explanation_md:
Partners must act faithfully for the common business and provide the relevant true accounts and information. A partner causing loss through fraud has the described indemnity responsibility. An agreement allocates many internal rights, but should not be read as permission for undisclosed fraud.

Each partner has the described participation and access rights. Ordinary business differences can be decided by majority after allowing partners to express their views; changing the nature of the business requires all partners consent. Distinguish a routine purchasing decision from abandoning the agreed business for another activity. Changing the partnership agreement itself also needs the applicable consent analysis.

self_check.prompt_text: Can a routine majority power alone authorise a change in the nature of business?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. That change requires all partners consent in the described framework.

payload.stem_md: A majority decides to replace the agreed transport business with an unrelated manufacturing venture over one partner objection. Which rule is relevant?

options.text_md: Every majority decision automatically binds internally
No business decision can ever be made by majority
options.explanation_md: Ordinary matters have a qualified majority route.

options.text_md: Changing the nature of business requires all partners consent
options.explanation_md: The proposal exceeds an ordinary business difference.

options.text_md: Only the bank can decide the business objects
options.explanation_md: The bank does not replace the partnership governance.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The proposal exceeds an ordinary business difference.

payload.stem_md: A partner conceals business receipts and offers a summary without underlying accounts. Which internal right matters?

options.text_md: True accounts, information and the applicable access rights
options.explanation_md: Disclosure and faithful dealing are part of the relationship.

options.text_md: Concealment is permitted whenever sales rise
options.explanation_md: Business success does not excuse concealment.

options.text_md: A majority can automatically legalise fraud
options.explanation_md: The duties cannot be dismissed by that shortcut.
The described partner rights are not reduced to that test.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Disclosure and faithful dealing are part of the relationship.
